resources.string: Builder, lab and pet upgrade timers
Next upgrade to finish and free builders

1. Add the Builder Timer widget to your home screen.

2. In Clash of Clans: Settings → More Settings → Data Export → Copy.

3. Tap Sync on the widget (or the button below).

Re-sync whenever you start new upgrades. You'll get a notification as each one finishes.

Your clipboard doesn't contain a Clash of Clans village export.

1. Open Clash of Clans
2. Go to Settings → More Settings → Data Export → Copy
3. Come back and press ⟳ Sync on the widget again
Village data is out of date

The export on your clipboard was copied %1$s, so any upgrades you've started or boosted since won't show.

For up-to-date timers:
1. Open Clash of Clans
2. Go to Settings → More Settings → Data Export → Copy
3. Come back and press ⟳ Sync on the widget again
Leave blank to show your player tag
Show finish time instead of countdown
Adds an estimate of how long is left for your Heroes, Guardians, Buildings, Pets and Lab, below your upgrades on the full widget.
Use the game\'s max, not my Town Hall\'s
Heroes, Guardians and Buildings share your builders, so each time assumes your builders work only on that type.\n\nItems you haven\'t built or unlocked aren\'t counted, and speed-ups are ignored.
Upgrades finishing in this window notify when it ends instead.
Add these once, then you can check and sync your timers without opening this screen.
The tile sits in quick settings and syncs without leaving the game.
Your home screen can\'t add widgets from here. Long-press an empty spot on it and choose Widgets instead.
The Sync timers tile is already in quick settings

1. Swipe down from the top of the screen to open quick settings.

2. Tap the edit button (a pencil).

3. Add Sync timers. On Samsung phones, tap Add a control and look under Builder Timer Widget.
Show Builder Base and Star Lab
Adds these upgrades to the widgets while any are running, and a Maxed line on the full widget once everything is at its top level. Time to max doesn\'t include them.
Show lab time on the small widget
Shows when your lab is next free, beside your free builders.
Choose what you\'re told about. Anything switched off here still shows on the widgets.
Home Village buildings, traps, heroes and guardians.
Notify me when these upgrades finish
Turning this off doesn\'t hide them from the widgets.
Potions and Clock Tower boosts ending
Tells you when a sped-up section is back to normal speed. Sync after using one so the app knows about it.
Sends one straight away to check notifications work. It ignores the switches above and quiet hours.
Your phone is blocking notifications from this app, so you won\'t hear when upgrades finish. Turn them on in your phone\'s settings.
You\'ve changed some settings but haven\'t saved them.
